h1: Facial Near Jimbaran and Nusa Dua: Is the Short Drive Worth It?
title_tag: Facial Near Jimbaran & Nusa Dua: Korean Skincare in Uluwatu
meta: Staying in Jimbaran or Nusa Dua? Our Korean facial studios in Ungasan and Bingin are a short drive away. Treatments, prices and how to get there.
intro: Jimbaran and Nusa Dua are home to many of Bali's big resorts, and their hotel spas are beautiful. But if you are looking for a results-driven Korean facial, the Bukit peninsula has more to offer just up the road. Our two Uluwatu studios are an easy trip from both areas.
body_html:
How far are we?

Approximate driving times in normal traffic (allow extra time around sunset, when traffic on the Bukit can double):

From To Point Face Ungasan To Point Face Bingin
Nusa Dua 15–30 min 35–50 min
Jimbaran 15–25 min 25–35 min

Tip: from Nusa Dua and Jimbaran, Point Face Ungasan is usually the closer studio. Grab and Gojek both work well in the area.

Hotel spa or facial studio?

Resort spa Point Face
Focus Relaxation, setting Skin results, Korean technology
Therapists Body and face Facial specialists
Skin analysis Not always Complimentary, before every treatment
Price Often higher, plus tax and service IDR 1,050K–1,500K for Hydrafacials, tax and service included

Many guests do both: a massage at their resort and a Korean facial with us.

Make it a half-day in the Bukit

  1. Late morning: facial at Point Face Ungasan.
  2. Lunch: a warung or a café in Ungasan.
  3. Afternoon: Melasti or Pandawa beach, SPF on.
  4. Sunset: Uluwatu Temple or a cliff bar, then back to Jimbaran for seafood dinner.

Treatments worth the drive

  • Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift (70 min, IDR 1,500K) — Ungasan only
  • Cryo Skin Reset (60 min, IDR 1,050K) — after too much pool time, Ungasan only
  • Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift (80 min, IDR 1,300K) — in both studios
  • Body Hydrafacials (back, chest, glutes) — Bingin only

Book your facial in Ungasan or Bingin →

Our two studios in Uluwatu

  • Point Face Ungasan — Jl. Toya Ning II No. 99, Ungasan, Kuta Selatan · WhatsApp +62 813 3793 880
  • Point Face Bingin — Jl. Pantai Cemongkak No. 9, Bingin Downtown Avenue, Pecatu · WhatsApp +62 823 3907 8379

Both open Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun 12:00–19:00. All prices include 15% tax and service charge.

faq: Is there a Korean facial near Nusa Dua?
Yes. Point Face Ungasan is about 12 km from Nusa Dua, roughly 15–30 minutes by car.
Which studio is closest to Jimbaran?
Point Face Ungasan, about 15–25 minutes away.
Do you offer hotel or villa visits?
No. Our treatments use professional machines that stay in the studio.
Can I book for the same day?
Often yes, depending on availability. Message the studio on WhatsApp.
